title: Hysab Kytab v1.1.1
message: High-Speed In-App Updater & Background Engine: Full line speed downloads via native Android DownloadManager, live MB/s progress, background downloading while minimized, instant already-downloaded detection, and auto-install on completion.
changelog: Full-speed 2 MB/s+ inside-app updates powered by Android OS native DownloadManager
Background download support: Keep downloading seamlessly even when minimizing the app or turning off the screen
Live transfer speed & progress indicator showing real-time MB/s and bytes downloaded
Smart local APK detection: Instantly recognizes already-downloaded packages without re-downloading
Automatic installation: Seamlessly launches the package installer as soon as the download finishes
Enhanced Khata ledger semantics with clear From and To counterparty routing
